description: Reference model-comparison values used in RLDS Papers III-IV.
sign_convention: Delta = RLDS - LCDM. Positive Delta chi2 / Delta BIC means the RLDS fit is disfavored relative to LCDM.
values_provenance: These chi2 / Delta BIC values are taken from the model-comparison table in Paper IV (Table 2, RLDS Papers III-IV). They are NOT recomputed by this SDK at import or test time, because the underlying model comparison is supernova-inclusive and requires the external Pantheon+ / Pantheon+SH0ES dataset (not redistributed here). The SDK can reproduce the model-level quantities (paired coefficient, spectral gap, attractor, present-day matter fraction) from code; the likelihood-level chi2 / BIC are traceable here but not re-derivable from the archive alone.
external_data_policy: Pantheon+ / Pantheon+SH0ES raw data are not redistributed in this SDK archive because they are an external third-party dataset. Full likelihood rerun requires the user to obtain the external Pantheon+ / Pantheon+SH0ES data from the official source and place it under the documented local data path.
notes: The raw external Pantheon+ / Pantheon+SH0ES dataset is not redistributed.
This SDK archive includes derived outputs, archived chains, summary arrays, and reference model-comparison values.
A full dynamic likelihood rerun requires the external dataset and the original likelihood environment.
The reference values are included to make the paper-level Delta chi2 and Delta BIC claims traceable without redistributing third-party data.

rlds_chi2_best (750.89), lcdm_chi2_best (714.67), and all deltas are taken directly from the Paper IV model-comparison table. chain_argmax_chi2 (750.9532) is the value of -2*logpost at the chain argmax stored in chains/summary.npy; it differs from the table value by 0.06 because logpost includes the prior, which is non-trivially active at the alpha prior floor (3.01).
Parameter counts: k_lcdm=2 (Omega_m, H0), k_rlds=5 (K, H0, R_c, Delta_R, alpha; Omega_m is derived, not counted). n_data=1605 (Pantheon+SH0ES 1590 SNe + DESI DR2 BAO 13 + Planck prior 2).
